A symmetric ideal chain with periodic Lefschetz behavior in positive characteristic — Alec Kriebel (ORCID0009-0001-9320-500X), v1.0.0 (2026-10-22), four-page preprint. An explicit compatible two-row symmetric Artinian ideal chain generated from width3 has WLP and SLP at width n>=2 exactly when p does not divide n-1 over every field of characteristic p; width1 is separately SLP. An integral torsion-free quotient basis and the determinant for every linear form prove the full classification. Over the single infinite field F_p(t), both good and bad widths are unbounded, disproving both unrestricted eventual dichotomies. Characteristic-zero and one-row variants are untouched.
